Bottle change.formula:
SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Month) = YEAR(Reporting_Month) AND MONTH(Month) <= MONTH(Reporting_Month)
  THEN IFNULL(Retail_Bottles_Sold, 0) + IFNULL(Wholesale_Bottles_Sold, 0) ELSE 0 END)
- SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Month) = YEAR(Reporting_Month) - 1 AND MONTH(Month) <= MONTH(Reporting_Month)
  THEN IFNULL(Retail_Bottles_Sold, 0) + IFNULL(Wholesale_Bottles_Sold, 0) ELSE 0 END)
